concerns.text: T008a-sample and T008c-precheck are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but have a strict sequential dependency. T008c reads the output of T008a (`data/raw/selected_ids.txt`) and modifies it if the size exceeds 6GB. They cannot run in parallel. Remove [P] from T008c-precheck.

T017a and T017b are marked [P] but have a strict sequential dependency. T017b reads `data/results/inclusion_metrics.json` generated by T017a to validate the rate. They cannot run in parallel. Remove [P] from T017b.

T021a (ECO collapsing) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T023/T024 in the description ('Dependency: This task MUST run before T023 and T024'). However, T021a generates `eco_mapping.json` which is likely required by T021 (feature preparation) and T022 (model fitting). The [P] tag is incorrect as it implies no dependencies, yet the task has explicit downstream consumers and upstream logic requirements. Remove [P] from T021a.

T008b-streaming description states 'Dependency: This task depends on T008a-sample and T008c-precheck'. While the dependency is correctly identified, the task is marked [P]. Since it consumes the output of T008c, it cannot be parallel with T008c. Remove [P] from T008b-streaming.
